synthetic_validation_paper.description: Scaled counterpart of the paper's synthetic validation (Table 1): a forward-moving monocular camera (96 frames) through a crowded, near-static hallway (a group of people stands across the walking line near the start and hides the rest of the hallway until the camera has passed them; subjects make small smooth unintended motions); every input camera pose is rendered at evaluator-chosen freeze instants (every 8th frame from a private per-scene offset, 12 instants) and compared with the true scene state at that instant. 40 hidden test scenes. Validity gate (zero inference overhead, instant selection): a submission is a frozen Gaussian state per timestamp with at most 64 primitives, rendered by the evaluator's fixed rasterizer; exceeding the budget, a missing scene, any non-finite/out-of-range value, or a state identical at every timestamp of a scene fails the run (worst value of every metric in every experiment). Non-underscore results are this gym's hidden-test reference values (4dgaussians = the same dynamic model without anchoring, for context; it is not a ranked slot); underscore results are the paper's reported numbers on its own scale.

psnr.description: Peak signal-to-noise ratio (dB) of each rendered view of a freeze-time video (every camera pose rendered at one freeze instant) against the true scene state at that instant, averaged over views, freeze instants and scenes. Per-view value capped monotonically at 100 dB (MSE floor 1e-10).

ssim.description: Windowed structural similarity (Gaussian window, sigma 1.5 px, along the image line, per channel) of freeze-time renders against the target; averaged over views, freeze instants and scenes. Range [-1, 1].

lpips.description: Perceptual-error proxy: mean absolute RGB error averaged over a 4-level resolution pyramid (2x average pooling). Stands in for LPIPS, which needs 2D images and a pretrained network.

fvd.description: Video-distance proxy: 1000 x mean absolute difference between the view-to-view temporal derivatives of the rendered and target freeze-time videos (flicker / temporal inconsistency). Stands in for FVD.

edge_mae.description: Mean absolute error of image-axis gradients; penalises blur, ghosting and double contours. Gym metric, not reported in the paper.

instant_selectivity.description: Constraint metric for user-selectable freeze instants (the capability the paper claims over static 3DGS, Sec. 6.4 / Table 4): fraction of the true instant-specific appearance change recovered, sum(|R_j - mean_j G| - |R_j - G_j|) / sum(|G_j - mean_j G|) over the evaluated freeze instants j of a scene, averaged over scenes. Range [-1, 1]; 1 = true freeze-time videos; any render that is the same for every instant scores at most 0; pixels that never change contribute nothing. A submission whose frozen state is identical at every timestamp of a scene fails the run outright.

synthetic_validation_paper._paper_results_note: Paper Table 1 (synthetic Blender scenes, 4DGaussians vs 4DGaussians + Splannequin, 2D images, true LPIPS/FVD). Not on this gym's scale (1D image lines, proxy LPIPS/FVD); kept for reference only.

synthetic_large_motion.description: Stress test from the paper's stated limitation (Sec. 7: the method assumes nearly static scenes and degrades under larger motion; motion thresholds left for future work). Same scenes, protocol, validity gate and metrics as synthetic_validation_paper, but subject motion is about 2x larger and decorrelates about 2x faster. 16 hidden test scenes. No paper numbers exist for this setting; results are this gym's hidden-test reference values.

_paper_unscored_results.note: Paper results this gym cannot measure (no real Mannequin-Challenge videos, CQA/COVER/IQA models or user study are available offline, and ablations are properties of the paper's method rather than of a submission). Kept unchanged for reference; not scored.
_paper_unscored_results.zero_inference_overhead_claim: Inference overhead 0.0 for Splannequin vs its base model (enforced in this gym as the primitive-budget validity gate).
